{{Otheruses|Colla}}
'''Colla''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Commenting on the entry for [[Mandroxan Exports]]' [[Defense Weapon EDWX-843]], Cholla noted that the weapon was good for disabling a target [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and recovering any information needed.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
